description: Runs a read-only git command (status, log, show, diff, blame, ls-files, shortlog, grep, describe, rev-parse, and listing branch or tag) in a repository inside the allowed folders, e.g. core_dump. Nothing is committed, checked out or pushed.

params.name: path
params.description: A folder in the repository, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump or tools (the agents repository)

params.name: command
params.description: The git subcommand: status, log, show, diff, blame, ls-files, shortlog, grep, describe, rev-parse, branch or tag

params.name: args
params.description: Its arguments, e.g. "-5 --oneline" for log or "HEAD~1 -- src/main.c" for diff; paths are relative to path
